variants.name: D1_ALL_IN
variants.note: riskier: TREND_D1 without the volatility dial, always the full sleeve when above SMA50

variants.name: D1_FAST
variants.note: riskier, more trades: SMA20 instead of SMA50, so it switches more often and pays more fees

variants.name: D1_HIGH_FEE
variants.note: same trades as TREND_D1 but pays 0.4% per trade, like a small account on a US exchange

variants.name: ALTS_TREND
variants.note: altcoins SOL and XRP with the TREND_D1 rule: hold while the daily close is above SMA50, else cash

variants.name: ALTS_HOLD
variants.note: benchmark: buys SOL and XRP at the start and holds

variants.name: MEME_TREND
variants.note: memecoins DOGE and PEPE with the TREND_D1 rule; no volatility dial, because on memecoins it would size orders under the $5 minimum

variants.name: MEME_HOLD
variants.note: benchmark: buys DOGE and PEPE at the start and holds

variants.name: GOLD_TREND
variants.note: gold via PAXG (1 token = 1 troy ounce) with the TREND_D1 rule; at most 50% per coin under the risk rules, the rest stays in cash

variants.name: GOLD_HOLD
variants.note: benchmark: buys $10 of PAXG gold at the start and holds
